_readme: Images for the home page, matched by id. Replace the files in the images/ folder (or change src). 'hero' = big arch photo at the top, 'custom' = photo beside Custom Orders, 'about-1/2/3' = polaroids in Our Story (caption shows under each), and every id starting with 'gallery' appears in the photo strip at the bottom — add as many gallery-N entries as you like.
